# rixl_image (Resource)

Uploads and manages image assets in Rixl with automatic dimensions calculation and thumbhash generation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_image" "hero" {
  project_id = var.rixl_project_id
  file_path  = "/path/to/hero.png"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_path` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `attached_to_video` (Boolean)
- `file` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--file))
- `height` (Number)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `thumbhash` (String)
- `visibility` (String)
- `width` (Number)
